steps.en: Officer opens the page to create one parking offence notice
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman untuk membuat satu parking offence notice

steps.en: Officer types the vehicle number, type and category
steps.id: Officer mengetik nomor, jenis, dan kategori kendaraan

steps.en: Officer enters when and where the offence happened
steps.id: Officer mengisi kapan dan di mana offence terjadi

steps.en: Officer enters the offence rule, fine amount and optional notes
steps.id: Officer mengisi aturan offence, jumlah denda, dan catatan opsional

steps.en: Officer submits and confirms; the form data is sent to the system
steps.id: Officer menekan Submit dan konfirmasi; data form dikirim ke sistem

steps.en: The system checks the data and saves it as a new notice
steps.id: Sistem mengecek data lalu menyimpannya sebagai notice baru

steps.en: Officer sees the new notice opened, or an error message
steps.id: Officer melihat notice baru terbuka, atau pesan error
